column1: # Editor corrections to the planned art briefs (content/art/briefs.jsonl). TAB-separated: slug, field, value.
# Fields: scene, setting, depiction (direct, historical, symbolic, atmospheric), divine_figure (none, light_silhouette),
#         people (yes, no), must_show, must_not_show, keep_vague (lists separated by ;), style, skip (yes).
# After editing, run ./gradlew :pipeline:artPlan. A changed brief gets a new hash, so it can be generated again.

column3: Light breaking over dark primeval waters at the dawn of creation, the first light dividing from darkness
the sun, moon and stars; birds, land animals and the first man and woman
A lush garden in Eden with rivers and trees in soft morning light; the first man and woman seen small and at a distance among the foliage
Moses, a shepherd, kneeling barefoot before a desert bush that burns with bright fire yet is not consumed, at the foot of a mountain, his flock nearby
the bush burning but not consumed
A humble stable at night in Bethlehem: Mary and Joseph beside a manger, the newborn child wrapped in swaddling clothes and glowing softly with light
the number of visitors; the child's features
A great crowd seated in groups on a green hillside beside the Sea of Galilee at evening; the luminous figure of Jesus holding loaves and fish while disciples carry baskets
Three crosses on a hill outside Jerusalem's walls under a darkened sky, seen from a distance; women watching in grief in the foreground
blood; wounds; close-up of the crucified
An empty rock-cut tomb in a garden at dawn, the great stone rolled away, bright light streaming from the open tomb, women arriving with spices
